origin: original finite-snapshot known-tone mathematical imaging observations

parameters.envelope: min(r/240,(2399-r)/240,1), r=n mod 2400, common to both sources
parameters.positive_frequency_convention: x[n]=Re(z exp(+j*2*pi*f*n/fs)); positive DFT uses exp(-j*...)
parameters.csm: R=(1/(2*20))*sum(z_l z_l^H), digital mean-square; interior-frequency tone only
parameters.channel_order: microphone 1, microphone 2; only source 2 is delayed at microphone 2
parameters.statistical_scope: zero cross term in specified balanced finite snapshot ensemble, not random independence

pcm: signed little-endian PCM16, nearest-even rounding; no dither, saturation or per-file gain
limits: Known 2kHz tones, deterministic balanced phase code and exactly known four-point propagation; not random-process independence, speech, a measured array, blind imaging, an inverse waveform or a listening evaluation. Digital amplitude squared is not Pa^2 or acoustic watts. No per-file normalization, clipping, fitted gain/delay, or circular shift.
listening: Start at low device volume; no autoplay or listening study.
